title: Opsis visual package manifest
description: DRAFT for v2 (promoted in V5, ADR-034). The manifest.json of an imported visual package (.opsisviz): a visual manifest that also names its author, the SDK version and its bundle. The import checks this schema, then the package rules in ADR-034 (one entry file, sizes, flat file names, the files the manifest names exist, the id is free).
